##### Project general facts

V1TER is a contemporary residential development in Dubai, thoughtfully designed to combine urban convenience with a calm, community-focused lifestyle. Positioned close to major city attractions while remaining away from crowded tourist areas, the project offers residents a peaceful living environment supported by excellent transport connectivity. Its setting encourages a balanced way of life, where daily routines are effortless and quieter moments can be fully enjoyed within a friendly residential neighborhood.

Rising 25 storeys, V1TER presents a collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments arranged around well-planned communal spaces. The development includes a landscaped podium, multi-functional public areas, and three levels of covered parking, all designed to enhance privacy and comfort. Residents have access to lifestyle amenities such as indoor and outdoor gyms, a sauna, and a swimming pool area with cabanas, sun loungers, and separate zones for adults and children, creating an environment that supports both relaxation and active living.

Interiors at V1TER feature a refined selection of durable and high-quality materials. Kitchen facades are made from 22 mm chipboard with low formaldehyde emissions (class E1) and finished with a melamine coating. Flooring is completed with tiles from Turkey, while frame furniture and LED-illuminated mirrors are supplied by the Italian brand Birex. Bathrooms are finished with Porcelanosa tiles from Spain. The kitchens are equipped with gas ovens and hobs, refrigerators, microwaves, and dishwashers by Candy, and the apartments include a smart home system. Residences are delivered semi-furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential communities, known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of urban and suburban living. Strategically located in the heart of new Dubai, JVC offers residents easy access to major attractions such as Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and Al Maktoum International Airport, all while maintaining a sense of tranquility away from the hustle and bustle of the city. With its modern infrastructure and extensive green spaces, the community is designed to provide a peaceful yet convenient lifestyle for residents of all ages.

The neighborhood is home to a diverse range of properties, including apartments, townhouses, and villas. JVC features an array of amenities, from parks and playgrounds to fitness centers, swimming pools, and walking trails, ensuring residents can enjoy an active and healthy lifestyle. The vibrant community also boasts numerous retail outlets, dining options, and supermarkets, making daily life incredibly convenient. Several nurseries and schools are located nearby, adding to its appeal for families with children.

One of the defining features of Jumeirah Village Circle is its focus on connectivity and community living. The area promotes interaction among residents with regular community events and shared spaces like landscaped gardens and outdoor seating areas. Despite its peaceful atmosphere, JVC remains well-connected through Dubai’s major road networks, allowing residents to easily commute to work or explore the city. It’s this unique blend of affordability, convenience, and community spirit that has made JVC a popular choice for those seeking a harmonious lifestyle in Dubai.
